params.name: urn
params.description: The URN of the entity whose timeline to retrieve.

params.name: aspectNames
params.description: The names of aspects to include in the timeline. If not specified, all aspects are returned.

params.name: startTimeMillis
params.description: Start of the time range in epoch milliseconds.

params.name: endTimeMillis
params.description: End of the time range in epoch milliseconds.

items.docs: Query the versioned history of an entity's aspects over time. Useful for tracking changes such as schema modifications, documentation updates, ownership transfers, and tag additions that have occurred on a given entity. Returns a chronological list of aspect versions with timestamps and audit information.
